source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Biometric Verification (PDF 127, printed 123).

blocks.text: Biometric verification pehchan ki tasdeeq ke liye jismani khoobiyan use karti hai, jaise fingerprints (ungliyon ke nishan), chehre ka scan ya awaz ka andaz. Biometrics accounts aur zaati data bachane ke liye hifazat ki mazboot tehein (layers) barhate hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba doosre qadam (teacher ka diya hua code) ke saath account mein login ki naqal (simulation) karein ta ke samajh aaye ke 2FA kaise kaam karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Biometric verification ki teen misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: Fingerprint (ungli ka nishan), face scan (chehra) aur voice pattern (awaz ka andaz).

items: Biometrics: jismani khoobiyon se pehchan ki tasdeeq; hifazat ki mazboot tehein (layers).
